name: Floralia
text: Today is the Floralia, the festival of Flora. There are garlands on every door, and the town wants flowers underfoot.

name: Neptunalia
text: Today is the Neptunalia. The fishing boats are hung with green branches, and everyone wants the sea on their floor.

name: Vinalia
text: Today is the Vinalia. The first of the new wine is opened, and the whole town is thinking about what to eat and drink.

name: Consualia
text: Today is the Consualia. There are races at the circus, and everyone is talking about horses and chariot wheels.

name: Saturnalia
text: Today is the Saturnalia. Masters wait on their slaves, everyone gives presents, and every house is laying on a feast.
